name: Occultic Pizza
source:
Deliver pizzas during Devil's Night, meeting with a weird cast of characters.
The pizzas you choose to deliver will influence the story.

[From [url=https://wandeer.itch.io/occultic-pizza-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
惡魔之夜，你出門送披薩，沿途遇見各式各樣的怪人。挑哪張披薩送過去，都會影響故事的走向。

［摘自[url=https://wandeer.itch.io/occultic-pizza-demo]itch.io[/url]］
